title: Choosing a scheduler from the curves
hook: A schedule is a list you can read before you spend a second of GPU. Two lists warned of the two broken renders in our sweep.

verified.claim: The stored sigma lists come from ComfyUI's scheduler code with the model's real range.
The lab's ports of ddim_uniform and linear_quadratic match those lists within 0.001.
We looked at the linear_quadratic, flow simple, flow karras and ddim_uniform renders before describing them.
nm_sigmas ran on a CPU and printed its lists.

unchecked: Linking a curve's shape to a broken render is our reasoning on one seed for each case. We did not sweep seeds or test other models.
SD 3.5 renders used a small preview VAE (TAESD3), because no full SD3 VAE was on the test machine, so fine detail in them should not be judged.
